Validate Trigger

Authorized incident commander / business owner approves failover

Promote / Fail Over Data Service

Shift Client Traffic

Validate Application & Data
Run smoke tests, critical journeys, data-integrity checks, and business validation

Operate from DR Region
Monitor SLOs, replication topology, security controls, and business KPIs

Plan Controlled Failback
After recovery, re-establish replication and perform a scheduled return when appropriate

Scheduled tabletop, failover, data-recovery and failback exercises

Communications
Incident bridge, stakeholder updates, customer communications and status
